Several Candidate-05 publication/binding counterexamples are now rejected and a genuine loan-review path still permits, so the author did not merely rename tests or deny every valid case. Remaining required behavior is still missing: static verification accepts an unrelated success-shaped receipt; live resource identity/pass scope are unread; CLI turns missing history into zeros, does not revalidate or charge through the bounded runner, ingests author-approved mismatched reviews, and marks outbox IDs delivered from status; doctor/host coverage are unobserved; the M4 reproducer hardcodes admitted-not-executed; repair/implement only print; SP05 actions borrow an SP01 campaign and are ineligible; sprint report is a constant table.
